english.note: Use this as the clearest all-purpose equivalent for any thing whatsoever.
Use this as the all-purpose noun phrase for any thing, especially when the thing is the focus rather than the choice pattern.

examples.english: If you don't understand anything, you can ask me.
examples.traditional: 你有任何嘢唔明，都可以問我。
